title: Blatnica Castle
visualBrief: Specific roofless Blatnica Castle core: narrow mapped ridge footprint, southwestern rounded jagged wall crown, long hollow palace walls and northeastern end, thick open window/door reveals, two low internal arch partitions and bounded exposed limestone ridge/court/short entrance approach. Three existing shared rubble-stone/raw-limestone/gravel graphs. No intact roofs, glass-filled ruins, copied sign/photo atlas, temporary construction platforms/tarps, separate shelter, whole mountain or invented complete lower bailey.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact-QID OSM way111989326 and native named castle35184484078158 fix the irregular44.356x10.423m core. Anchor18.947088674,48.947190751/global heading0/native east-south axes; internal NE-SW axis0.625590709588rad follows retained/native footprint. The western aerial places the rounded broken end southwest and the opposite end northeast. Fine aperture/gateway allocation and hidden lower works retain20degree/2m uncertainty; no surveyed signed facade detail is claimed.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No retained or native qualified height. Picture-led wall height knots range roughly4.5..13.5m above the sloping bounded ridge/court, with deeply broken crowns rather than intact parapets. Opening sizes, wall thickness1.25m, internal arch partitions and fine damage/conservation inventory remain approximate. The bare floor follows a coarse terrain-supported profile, not a measured historic floor datum.
